Thousand-year Holy Blood Fruit, surrounded by inner ghosts (Thousand-year Holy Blood Fruit, surrounded by inner ghosts) (The Thousand-Year Holy Blood Fruit, surrounded by inner ghosts (Unexpectedly) Before I could finish my words, I secretly ate a soul-killing bell and was immediately slapped by Mo Fan, who was incomparable and looked like a ghost. His mouth was full of steel teeth and shattered into pieces. Without saying a word, the somewhat heroic face suddenly swelled into a pig's head. People lamented that the battle was an anticlimactic one, but they also marveled at the strength of the Mo family and sincerely admired Mo Xiaotian's ability to overcome the enemy. Extraordinary abilities. Was it that time during the competition between the Su family and the Lin family who had been destroyed by his great grandfather, the two Heart Lamp monks? Shulka liked this feeling: he could not hear the sound of gunfire outside, and there was no stench of blood and mud. Looking up through the round window, the flames of the gunfire outside were as brilliant as fireworks... It was like being isolated from the world, as if all the pain and danger were gone.
